detail.composition_rule: In the harness a repair is read on top of its plant by adding the two edits' weight deltas (weight_edits.stack, with the plant first); on a checkpoint carrying the planted weights the repair would act on those weights. On a neuron (a down_proj column, or a gate_proj or up_proj row) that both change, the two differ: two scales f1 and f2 give f1 + f2 - 1 of the base in the harness and f1 x f2 on a checkpoint (a scale x2 on a silenced neuron restores it in the harness, 0 + 2 - 1 = 1, and leaves it silenced on a checkpoint, 0 x 2 = 0); a set over a scaled or added neuron keeps the plant's change in the harness and stands alone on a checkpoint (a set back to the base on a silenced neuron leaves it silenced in the harness and restores it on a checkpoint); a scale over an added or set neuron scales the base in the harness and the planted weights on a checkpoint. Two compose the same both ways: an added vector, and a set over a set (the later set stands). So does a repair on neurons the plant did not change. Not known: a low-rank term on a linear the other edit changes, and a remove_direction on a planted neuron (its vector is worked out from the weights it is built on).

What the knob leads above were judged against (backend/level_knobs.py): a knob claim faces the families of controls its knob takes, which are not a weight edit's controls. By family:
- other_sites_matched: other neurons of the same layers, drawn by the weight path's own matched draw (weight_edits.matched_control_edits) for the weight edit whose arithmetic the knob is (its neurons' down_proj columns scaled by its factor), and read as that edit's controls are read: each stand-in is within a factor of 2 of its neuron on what a base pre-pass over the items read, as the knob reads them, expects it to deliver over the answer. Not matched on what they delivered as read, over the prompt, or at the last position.
- same_site: the knob's own neurons, their down_proj columns changed along random directions off the layer's quiet mask, each column's change as long in the stream as the knob's (weight_edits.same_site_controls), read as that edit's controls are read. Matched on the size of each column's change, not on its direction.
- random_directions: pushes at the same layers, of the same length (|dose x scale|) and the same start-mark rule, along random directions off each layer's quiet mask. Matched on the size of the push at the layer where it is added; not on what it does further up, nor on how hard any neuron fires: a random direction is no neuron's write direction, and a knob whose direction was chosen from readings is set beside directions that were not.

blinded_31b.blinding_note: Each case ran under a neutral id, a hash of its id and a nonce drawn for the run, as its session's id and its folder's name; which case and kind each id is, is kept in these records, outside anything a driver sees. kind_or_id_words_shown lists the cases whose status reply, harness card, driver prompt or work path (below the benchmark's folder) showed a kind word or a word of the case's id (as whole words; reach names aside): a case listed there was not blinded.
blinded_31b.door_surface_note: A plumbing check. At the start of each session, before its driver runs, it takes what the door shows a driver (the tools served with their schemas, the status reply, and the driver prompt), leaving out the session id, the backend (which names the driver family) and the wall-clock fields, and compares planted and canary sessions at the same reach. It shows that the door does not say which kind a session is. It does not show that a driver cannot tell from its readings: a plant changes them, as it is meant to.

answer_says.abstained: the door took a propose_repair whose edit was null: an explicit abstention
answer_says.proposed a repair: the door took a propose_repair with an edit, kept as built when it was submitted
answer_says.no proposal recorded: the door took no propose_repair: the driver never called it (it stopped, or one of its caps stopped it, first), or the door refused every call it made (`proposal_refusals` gives the door's words: an edit the gate refused, a missing or wrong argument, a call after the session's wall-clock cap). Not an abstention, and not a measurement: the case is scored "no proposal recorded" and left out of both rates

blinded_31b.scripted_baseline_note: The scripted baseline submits an abstention by rule in every blinded session, whatever it read: a check that propose_repair's path works, never a measurement of a driver. It feeds neither rate.
